summary: Vehicle suspension query accessor. Calls SuspensionSpringDamperForceComputationWithClampi with the body pointer at this+0x1EC and the rigid-body state read from this+0x15F0, writing into two local result vectors v4 and v5. Copies v4 into output float array a2 and v5 into output float array a3, then returns a3. Called by sub_4F0430 (004F0430) on the per-frame path.

local_names.this: vehicle/body object whose suspension parameters and rigid-body state are queried
local_names.a2: output float[3] receiving the v4 result vector
local_names.a3: output float[3] receiving the v5 result vector, also the return value
local_names.v4: first result vector (double[3]) filled by the suspension computation
local_names.v5: second result vector (long double[3]) filled by the suspension computation

operations.description: Call SuspensionSpringDamperForceComputationWithClampi with the body pointer (this+0x1EC), the rigid-body state dword read from this+0x15F0, and local result vectors v4/v5
a2[0..2] = v4[0..2]: copy the first three result elements into output array a2
result = a3: set the return value to the second output array
a3[0..2] = v5[0..2]: copy the second three result elements into output array a3
Invoked from sub_4F0430 (004F0430) on the per-frame tick path
